Artificial Intelligence & Computational Biology

Ziheng Duan

Postdoctoral researcher · Yale University

Prof. Mark Gerstein’s lab

I develop trustworthy computational methods to understand single-cell gene regulation, particularly in spatial contexts, and translate these insights into disease understanding and drug discovery.

Google Scholar ↗GitHub ↗Email ↗

I earned my Ph.D. in Computer Science at UC Irvine, advised by Prof. Jing Zhang. My research connects single-cell genomics and spatial transcriptomics with therapeutic target discovery. I also work with Genesis Molecular AI in computational biology.
